statusLine.command: d=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/scripts/statusline.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; [ -f "$d/scripts/statusline.py" ] && python3 "$d/scripts/statusline.py" || true

hooks.command: d=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/scripts/path_guard.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=${d%/*}; done; [ -f "$d/scripts/path_guard.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/scripts/path_guard.py" || exit 0
